world: four one-hot odours; avoid (0) or approach (1); approach the sugar odour +1, another odour -1, avoid 0; odours 0 and 1 are the reversal pair (sugar at 0 under rule A, at 1 under rule B); odour 2 is always sugar and odour 3 never
life: one stream, no resets: rule A for the exposure, rule B for `after` trials, rule A again for `after` trials; changes are unannounced

gates.statement: over the confirmation lives of the live arm at exposures of 300 and more, at least `share` end each rule with `final` of their last 100 executed actions optimal, keep the stable pair right on `stable` of their probes, and spend no more than `aroused_late` of the second half of each rule aroused; at each of those exposures the median reversal lag is at most `lag_bound` trials, a life that never reverses counting as beyond it. Exposure 100 ends inside the youth and is reported without a gate.
